headline: No signed Hormuz deal expected yet from Oman meeting on Monday, Iranian official says
summary: A senior Iranian official said Monday's Oman meeting with Gulf states will discuss Hormuz and other regional issues but is not expected to produce a signed agreement over the blockaded strait. Iran still wants a framework allowing it to collect fees from ships using the strait, which Oman rejects. This is a substantive negative update for near-term de-escalation expectations beyond Bahrain's previously covered refusal to attend, although the talks themselves remain scheduled.
